iPhone随手拍纪实：iPhone Snapshot / Candid Mobile Photography
时尚杂志大片：High-End Fashion Editorial / Studio Portraiture

街头纪实扫街：Street Documentary Photography / Candid Snapshot

1.背景外壳描述 / Background Shell (background)
都市末日废墟：Desolate post-apocalyptic cityscape shell with crumbling concrete buildings
雨后霓虹街道：Rain-slicked asphalt street reflecting blurred neon lights
纯净摄影棚背景：Solid minimalist studio backdrop / Clean concrete wall
深海/星空外壳：Deep abyssal ocean shell / Boundless starry night sky with nebula

2.三层景深控制 / Depth of Field (compositional_deconstruction)
前景（常用于失焦遮挡）：Foreground blur / Out-of-focus elements in foreground
中景（核心主体层）：Focal subjects in midground / Asymmetric composition in midground
远景（背景融合层）：Distant simplified scenery / Silhouette in the deep background

3. 灯光与色彩控制 / Lighting & Color Control
💡 官方避坑提示：禁止使用 "warm"（温暖的）作为全局色调修饰词，这会触发 AI 特有的黄色大泛光。精准控色必须使用 color_palette 中的大写 6 位 Hex 字符串（如 "#FF5733"）。

物理布光方式 / Studio & Ambient Lighting
丁达尔光瀑/光：Dramatic Tyndall effect / God rays cutting through haze
柔光箱（面部无死角微高光）：Softbox illumination / Subtle highlights on skin textures
单侧硬调雷达罩（雕刻感）：Hard single-side Beauty Dish lighting with crisp shadows
赛博朋克双色环境光：Dual-tone ambient lighting (e.g., cyan and magenta light sources)
冷中性白平衡：Cool-neutral white balance / Accurate natural daylight

4. 角色外观与材质 / Character Appearance & Textures

发型与面部 / Hair & Face Features
电光蓝波波头：Electric-blue bob-cut hair
银色利落短发：Sleek silver short hair
微光眼神光（拒绝死鱼眼）：Clear and sharp catchlight in the eyes
机械面部接缝：Polished titanium cybernetic plating and seams on the cheek
服装与道具材质 / Clothing & Props Material
半透明科技面料：Semi-transparent high-tech mesh fabric
哑光黑战术防弹衣：Matte-black tactical ballistic vest
拉丝金属与铜线：Brushed metallic textures with exposed copper wiring
皮革折痕与磨损：Weathered leather clothing with visible creases and scuffs

5. 平面设计与高级排版 / Typography & Graphic Design

字体类别与样式 / Font Categories
现代无衬线体（科幻/机甲）：Modern bold sans-serif typeface
优雅高衬线体（时尚/复古）：Elegant high-contrast serif font
粗犷工业风字体（废土/军事）：Rugged industrial-style block font
未来感全息晶体字：Futuristic holographic crystalline typography
模拟手写马克笔体：Rough handwritten marker font
文字排版与视觉效果 / Text Effects & Layout
多行垂直堆叠：Vertically stacked text layers
单线电子发光蓝：Monoline electronic neon-blue glow effect
带重影的故障风字体：Glitch art typography with subtle cyan chromatic aberration
与建筑表面贴合的店招：Stylized signage typography affixed onto the building facade
